tier_beginner_blurb: Sees one move ahead and often slips up: ideal for discovering skills.
tier_amateur_blurb: Looks two moves ahead and sometimes leaves a piece hanging.
tier_club_blurb: Plays solidly, rarely makes big mistakes, and uses its skills wisely.
tier_expert_blurb: Calculates four moves ahead and punishes almost every inaccuracy.
tier_master_blurb: Thinks longer, plays precisely and makes the most of every skill.
tier_grandmaster_blurb: The strongest: deep calculation, full evaluation, practically no mistakes.
note: No clock, no Elo at stake, no reward. No account needed.
